name: UndergroundDevelopmentAdvanceTracker
tagline: Every development heading, the drill–charge–fire–bog–support cycle and metres vs plan – in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete underground development app for Power Apps: heading register by level, a live cycle board with stage-time targets, round recording with advance and overbreak limits, ground-support gating, holds, pro-rata plan attainment with month-end forecast and level progress strips with metres and days to finish. Works instantly with fictional demo data; connect any collection, Dataverse, SharePoint, Excel or SQL table and map the columns from dropdowns.
features: Five-stage development cycle with skip and backward-move rules
Record round: metres, overbreak, over-length and overbreak notes
Ground support class required before the next round
Stage target hours and late-face flags
Plan vs actual with expected-by-today marker and forecast
Level strips with metres, rounds and days to finish
Bulk advance / hold / resume / assign with rule-checked skips and Undo
CSV export, search, filters, grouping, sorting, paging
Power Fx outputs and OnSelect / OnChange / OnCreate / OnSave / OnAction / OnStatusChange events
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and screen-reader support
pack: Niray Mining & Natural Resources PCF Pack
react: 16.14.0 (bundled, no platform library, no Fluent UI)
